history.period: Center established ~2015 (per JustDial); new temple building inaugurated 1 December 2022
history.summary: IDENTITY NOTE: The CSV gives only 'ISKCON Temple, Gurgaon' with no sector. Documented here is ISKCON Gurugram's main temple, the Sri Sri Radha Damodar Mandir at ISKCON Sudarshan Dham, Badshahpur, Sector 67 on the Gurugram-Sohna Road, which carries the official ISKCON Gurugram presence (iskcongurugram.com). The new temple building, in Rajasthani architectural style, was inaugurated on 1 December 2022 with the installation of Sri Sri Radha Damodar and Sri Sri Gaur Nitai deities, graced by Gopal Krishna Goswami and Bhakti Bhringa Govinda Swami; over 20,000 people attended the two-day program with 1,150+ bhoga items offered. JustDial lists the Badshahpur center as established 2015 (11 years in business), so the center predates the 2022 temple building. A separate, older ISKCON Gurugram center exists near Delhi Public School, Sector 45 - if the CSV intended that one, this identification should be revisited. The temple runs a large Anna Daan / Food for Life free-prasadam program (10,00,000+ meals claimed) and 15+ community and education programs.
